Borrowing and returning - Ostfalia University of Applied Sciences
Skip to main content
Borrowing and returning
Would you like to know how to borrow, renew or return books?
You can find more information in the following sections.
Lending
Lending
The majority of the library stock can be borrowed. The
lending periods
can be:
4 weeks (normal loan),
1 week (short loan) and
Books in presence, which can be borrowed overnight or over the weekend.
The signs directly on the book will tell you what type of lending it is. Short-term and on-call lendings have a sticker above the signature label. Normal lendings does not have a sticker.
Please check all media for damage before borrowing! If you notice any damage, please report it to the service desk before borrowing. Otherwise you are liable for the damage.
Ordering books and other media from the library of another Ostfalia location
If you find media in the library catalogue at another location that you need at another Ostfalia location, you can order them there free of charge. We will send literature to any Ostfalia library location on request.
Please make a note of the corresponding
shelfmarks
(letter-number combinations of the book) of the media from our library catalogue.
Then send us the signatures of the media you require
by email
,
Your
library number
and
the
location
where you would like to collect them.
It usually takes
one to three days
for your ordered media to be available at the Ostfalia location of your choice.
You have
seven days to collect the
items once they have been made available.
Lending period extension
You can renew items
online up to seven times
as long as they are not reserved and no fees are outstanding.
Please check carefully after each renewal whether and for which media the lending period has actually been extended!
If you need media beyond this period, you must present them at the library for a new lending.
E-mail notifications
Email notifications
As a service, the library will send e-mails to your (Ostfalia) e-mail address:
three days before the lending period expires,
when reservations or interlibrary lendings are received and
when you place a hold on your borrowed media.
Please check your user account regularly.
This service is non-binding!
Return
Books can be returned at any location and only at the circulation desk during
opening hours
.
Outside opening hours, a book return box is available at each location.
No library card is required to return media.
It is also possible to return items by post, although you are liable for any damage or loss. The postmark is decisive for the time limit.
Reminders
If you exceed the lending period, a reminder will be sent to your registered (Ostfalia) e-mail address. Please pay all outstanding fees immediately, as all lending and renewal functions will be automatically blocked. The fee scale is structured as follows:
1. Reminder level: 2 Euro
2. Reminder level: 5 euros
3. Reminder level: 10 euros.
The amounts add up at each level. After consultation with the
library
, reminder fees can be transferred. Payment by Ostfalia Card is not possible. EC-cards are accepted.
Detailed information can be found in the
Fee Regulations
(external link, opens in a new window)
of the State of Lower Saxony for Academic Libraries.
Please remember to return or extend the deadline in good time!
Special conditions for Bachelor, Master, interns
Are you writing your thesis soon or doing an internship abroad?
No problem! We give Ostfalia students the opportunity to borrow books for a longer period of time. Further information on this can be found in our
information sheet
.
For Bachelor's and Master's graduates:
Submit a copy of your completed application for admission to the Bachelor's or Master's thesis as a copy, scan or forward the examination board's email to the library of an Ostfalia location of your choice. The start of the processing period and the submission date of the thesis should be indicated. (Contact:
Library Wolfenbüttel
(opens your email program)
,
Library Wolfsburg
(opens your email program)
,
Library Salzgitter
(opens your email program)
,
Library Suderburg
(opens your email program)
)
For interns:
The
Student Service Office (SSB)
will issue you with the relevant certificate.
External users
External users are always welcome at the Ostfalia Library!
You can find everything you need to know about registration and terms of use in the following points or in our clever Ostfalia clip
"External users"
(external link, opens in a new window)
.
Registration
To use our library, you need a library card, which you can obtain at all Ostfalia Library locations.
We offer the following usage models:
3 months : 5,00 EUR
12 months : 12,00 EUR
The membership fee can be paid in cash or by ec card.
To issue a library card, we need from you
valid identity card or passport with registration certificate (not older than ½ year)
Please note:
Minors
also require a
declaration of consent (PDF, 26.43 KB)
(opens in a new window), (not accessible)
completed by their parents and a copy of one parent's identity card (front and back).
Exempt from the obligation to pay fees are
Pupils under the age of 18,
Vocational school students
Welfare recipients and the unemployed,
Students of the TU Braunschweig, HBK Braunschweig and Leuphana University Lüneburg.
Appropriate identification/proof must be presented at the library. Only a fee of EUR 5.00 will be charged for issuing the library card.
Borrowing and usage modalities
We offer the following services for external users:
borrow up to
10 books/journals (volumes) at the same time
time limits for borrowed media can
be extended
up to 7 times online and independently in the
lending account
use our library PCs for working and for internet and database searches (registration at the service desk required)
copy and print on site for a fee (please enquire about prices at the service desk)
use the book scanner free of charge using a USB stick you have brought with you
reminders are sent by post
Cookie Notice
In order for our website to function technically, we use necessary cookies. In addition, optional cookies enable the best possible use of the site. By ticking the box you give your consent. You can revoke your consent at any time. More information in our
privacy policy
